# New brochure "Benchtop & portable meters"


Our new brochure is structured according to areas of application: First, you will find our laboratory measuring devices (benchtop) for stationary use, followed by robust portable measuring devices for mobile applications. Selection guides, technical specifications, and application examples will help you choose the optimal device for your requirements.
